# Text.PositionOf

```m
Text.PositionOf(text as text, substring as text, optional occurrence as nullable number, optional comparer as nullable function) as any
```

Returns the position of the specified occurrence of the text value `substring` found in `text`.
An optional parameter `occurrence` may be used to specify which occurrence position to return (first occurrence by default).
Returns -1 if `substring` was not found.

`comparer` is a `Comparer` which is used to control the comparison. Comparers can be used to provide case-insensitive or culture and locale-aware comparisons.

The following built-in comparers are available in the formula language:

- `Comparer.Ordinal`: Used to perform an exact ordinal comparison

- `Comparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase`: Used to perform an exact ordinal case-insensitive comparison

- `Comparer.FromCulture`: Used to perform a culture-aware comparison

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `text` | no |
| `substring` | `text` | no |
| `occurrence` | `nullable number` | yes |
| `comparer` | `nullable function` | yes |

## Examples (engine metadata — not verified here)

Get the position of the first occurrence of "World" in the text "Hello, World! Hello, World!".

```m
Text.PositionOf("Hello, World! Hello, World!", "World")
```

Stated result:

```m
7
```

Get the position of the last occurrence of "World" in "Hello, World! Hello, World!".

```m
Text.PositionOf("Hello, World! Hello, World!", "World", Occurrence.Last)
```

Stated result:

```m
21
```
